title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - RunningTrack
description: Running track (era:RunningTrack's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): A running track means any track used for train service movements; passing loops and meeting loops on plain line or track connections only required for train operation are not published Inherits attributes from era:Track/era:InfrastructureElement/era:Feature (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RunningTrack'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

additionalBrakingInformationDocument.description: Relationship. Electronic document available in two EU languages from the IM stored by the Agency providing additional information as defined in point (2) of point 4.2.2.6.2 of TSI OPE. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.11.3)

maxPermittedTrainLength.description:
Property. Maximum train length in meters allowed on a section of line, without special permission, for the operation of freight trains. 
                            In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2024/1679, Article 15(2)(c), this maximum length must be supported by the infrastructure manager's ability 
                            to allocate sufficient train paths for freight trains of at least 740 meters (including the locomotive or locomotives), as required for the TEN-T network.

maximumAltitude.description: Property. Highest point of the section of line above sea level in reference to Normal Amsterdam's Peil (NAP). (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.2.7)

maximumBrakingDistance.description: Property. The maximum value of the braking distance [in metres] of a train shall be given for the maximum line speed. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.11.1)

maximumPermittedSpeed.description: Property. Nominal maximum operational speed on the line as a result of infrastructure, energy and control, command signalling subsystem characteristics expressed in kilometres/hour. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.2.5)

maximumTrainDeceleration.description: Property. Limit for longitudinal track resistance given as a maximum allowed train deceleration and expressed in metres per square second. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.6.1)

minimumHorizontalRadius.description: Property. Radius of the smallest horizontal curve of the track in metres. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.3.7, 1.2.2.0.3.2)

minimumWheelDiameter.description: Property. Maximum unguided length of fixed obtuse crossings is based on a minimum wheel diameter in service expressed in millimetres. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.5.2)

nationalLoadCapability.description: Property. National classification for load capability (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.1.2.4.1)

canonicalURI.description:
Property. The canonical URI is defined for each instance of an Infrastructure element, e.g. section of line, operational point, track, tunnel, siding.
Objects of the infrastructure generated through RML mappings include (when provided) their validity start and end dates. With its identifier, plus all identifiers of its "parent" elements, and its validity dates, a hash URI is generated.
The canonical URI is the element's URI with its identifiers and without the validity dates. All of the hash URIs of an element point to its canonical URI.
Additionally, SoLs point to the canonical URIs of their start OP and end OP.

exemptSpecialVehiclesFromRMR.description: Property. Indicates whether special vehicles are exempted from the need to install RMR (Railway Mobile Radio) for this infrastructure element.
